name: Document Intake — Filing Happy Path
query: Add this to the Bradys — it's their new POA
expected_behavior: Step 1: Calls Wealth:find_client with the name the advisor used
Step 2: Finds two matching households and asks which, as a table, before any upload call
Step 3: On the advisor naming California, calls Wealth:upload_extract_document with wid, fileName, fileKind, and advisorConfirmed left unset
Step 4: Lets the tool's own step-up confirmation fire rather than self-attesting advisorConfirmed: true
Step 5: On confirmation, states the document is filed and being sent, without claiming it has been read
Step 6: Calls Wealth:get_extraction_result once with wait left unset (holding), not in a polling loop
Step 7: On a running result with a retry_after_ms, waits that long before checking again rather than immediately
Step 8: On succeeded, offers the summary by document name and defers further detail to wealth-estate-document-deep-dive
success_criteria: Nothing is filed before the client is resolved and confirmed
advisorConfirmed is only ever set to true following an explicit, client-named advisor confirmation in the transcript
get_extraction_result is called exactly once per reading collected, not in a call-back-to-back loop
The answer never claims the document is 'uploaded' before real confirmation the bytes moved
Tool sequence is Wealth:find_client (1x or 2x if disambiguation needed) then Wealth:upload_extract_document (1x) then Wealth:get_extraction_result (1x, possibly holding)
must_not: any call to extract_document, get_document_info, or confirm_document_split — none exist
advisorConfirmed: true without a preceding explicit, client-named confirmation
a second upload_extract_document call for the same file within this happy path
an estimate of when the reading will finish
the words report, scenario, estate flow, heritage map, risk analysis, insights
